sources.summary: JA House is shaped by the unique character of its site in southern Amman , overlooking one of the city's largest public parks with uninterrupted panoramic views. The steep topography and the preserved oak trees along the site's perimeter inspired a concept centered on a green terraced platform that extends the landscape into the architecture while naturally embedding the main living spaces within the terrain.
